description: Irregular waves breaking on a 1:20 slope (Mase & Kirby 1992), NHFLOW. The waves are linear components (0.2-3 Hz, 1147 components; SFLOW 0.2-1.6 Hz with the improved-dispersion pressure A 220 3, since the depth-averaged model cannot carry the short components) from the FFT of the first 409.6 s of the measured record at the slope toe (h = 47 cm; waverecon.dat written by tools/mase_kirby_waverecon.py, the decomposition of FUNWAVE-TVD's fft4wavemaker.m), generated in a 2.5 m relaxation zone (B 92 51; the record is reproduced at the wave origin x = 0, the toe gauge sits at x = 2.75 m; B 105 cannot move the origin because it also moves the relaxation zone). Significant wave height Hm0 = 4 sigma and skewness at the gauges (h = 47 ... 2.5 cm) against the measured records over the same time window.

reference.citation: Mase, H. & Kirby, J.T. (1992) Hybrid frequency-domain KdV equation for random wave transformation. Proc. 23rd ICCE, 474-487; measured records (dt 0.05 s, 12 gauges on a 1:20 slope) from the FUNWAVE-TVD benchmark car_mase_kirby, see refdata/PROVENANCE_git_sources.md

check.note: the measured record contains frequencies below 0.2 Hz that the generated waves do not (Hm0 at the toe gauge: 6.62 cm generated, 6.65 cm measured)
